OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
            Optional on create; when omitted the server defaults it to the current date. The
            effective date (supplied or defaulted) must fall on a business day, so a Saturday or
            Sunday is rolled forward to the following Monday before it is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Request-only hint. When true, permits creating this owner even when
            another owner has the same last name and address (a shared household); ignored
            (defaults false) otherwise. Not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned membership code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where
                CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 is the upper-cased
                first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a per-city 4-digit zero-padded
                sequence (one more than the owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Assigned membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two digits of the
                registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable shared identifier for owners in the same household (same last
                name and address). Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true
                and joins an existing same-household owner; both then share this identifier.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F60718'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively). Computed
                once at creation before this owner is persisted, then stored and returned.
